en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town with cobblestone streets curving between multi‑storey houses. In the background stands a large Gothic church with tall spires and a clock tower. In the foreground is a corner building with arched shopfronts and German writing on the façade. A few people, including a woman and a child, walk along the street, and a tram or carriage track runs through the scene. The overall look suggests an early‑20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard.
